kind: saved-row replay; new history fits require a separate sealed input admission
exposure: old reported aggregates and one null outcome inspected; all years exposed development
inherited_replay_horizon: actual saved per-game issued_at; not relabeled T-90
history_rule: same evaluation identities; train and transforms only on earlier available outcomes; freeze fit window separately from feature memory
participation: score only verified played with valid explicit target; DNP/unknown/missing kept in coverage
paired: same player/game/target and identical supported outcomes; baseline recent versus pooled; no head-to-head on unmatched totals
uncertainty: whole-week paired-loss mean bootstrap, 500 replicates seed1703, only with >=8 independent observed weeks; otherwise insufficient_clusters; game-cluster sensitivity only >=8 games
probability_rules: no clipping; endpoint log failures infinite; no distribution claim from point/Poisson objective
selection: none new; actual offers and frozen selection prerequisites must be satisfied first
private_storage: no approved durable V2 private store currently bound; do not fit dependent research or claim local cache durable
production: read-only; retained owner controls integration, capture and schedules
new_reconstruction_horizon: kickoff left-limit inherited common contract; actual information availability separately qualified
alternate_horizon: T-minus90 is a separately named possible V2 product, not used to relabel inherited forecasts
